corrected_code:
audit_router = APIRouter(prefix="/users/{user_id}/security", tags=["user-audit"])

@audit_router.get("/login-events")
async def get_user_login_events(
    user_id: uuid.UUID,
    limit: int = Query(25, ge=1, le=100),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
    current_user: User = Depends(current_active_user)
):
    if current_user.id != user_id and not current_user.is_superuser:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: access to user security logs denied")

    stmt = (
        select(UserLoginAudit)
        .where(UserLoginAudit.user_id == user_id)
        .order_by(UserLoginAudit.created_at.desc())
        .limit(limit)
    )
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    records = res.scalars().all()
    return [{"timestamp": r.created_at, "ip": r.client_ip, "user_agent": r.user_agent, "location": r.geo_city} for r in records]
